buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Cobolli gets a slim nod on freshness. Cobolli has 41 games on the legs over 14 days (2 matches) against 113 for Alcaraz (5).

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Alcaraz gets a slim nod on motivation and pressure. Alcaraz is on the way up (+11 Elo over 90 days) while Cobolli has been sliding (-80). Alcaraz's comeback rate is 60% against 32% for Cobolli, which matters if the first set slips away. Offsetting that, Cobolli is playing at home in Inalpi Arena, Turin, Italy, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Alcaraz holds a clear advantage on conditions. Alcaraz is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 90% wins in 12 months against 53% for Cobolli. Alcaraz has 23 matches on Indoor Hard in the last 90 days, Cobolli only 13, so the adjustment period is shorter. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.
